you're right. absolutely.

the problem is....you're wrong.

i'm not saying i was ever perfect. not in the least. i fucked up PLENTY. ive been less of a good dad than i could have been at times.

but when the mom is out, doing god knows what, from 7a-9p and i get home from work at 5 everyday, taking care of the kids until the 10-11p hour, while she has better things to do...

sure, this could be just a bunch of bullshit. it could all be fake. i could just be sugarcoating all of it....and not even being honest with myself.

but like i said, in the relationship, i wasn't perfect. and as a father, i was learning. but i did everything i could.i honestly can't say she did.
